items.title: Stock Radar: Breakout from a symmetrical triangle makes Whirlpool of India stock an attractive buy; what should investors do?
items.description: Whirlpool of India stock has broken out of a symmetrical triangle pattern on daily charts. Experts suggest short-term traders can buy the stock for a target of Rs 1,030-1,140 in the next 3-4 weeks. The stock has shown significant gains in recent weeks. Technical indicators like RSI and MACD signal bullish momentum.
